result:
I verified both round-1 findings as fixed, but my verdict on candidate `e6979e12…` is **FAIL**. A required end-to-end (e2e) test failed intermittently, and I recorded that run as FAIL rather than passing it after reruns. I logged it as one new Low, non-mandatory finding, F-DG1-232. Every other required check passed and all 12 requirements are verified.

**Identity:** the candidate ID matches on the working tree, at the frozen commit `485e91f` and at HEAD `309be8d`. The commits after the freeze only add delivery records (assignments, manifest, stages.json).

**Round-1 findings, both closed and verified:**
- **F-DG1-230:** the three views are now in the data dictionary and the ERD. I checked them against a freshly migrated database: 3 views and 11 columns, all with matching types.
- **F-DG1-231:** the two register rows no longer cite the old candidate or say "implemented only if". All 30 files they cite exist.

**Checks that passed:**
- **Static:** typecheck, build, lint, OpenAPI lint (33 operations), no-CDN scan, formatting and contrast all exit 0.
- **Unit tests:** 326/326 on Node 22 and on Node 24. The web test behind F-DG1-144 passed in all 6 parallel runs under load.
- **Integration:** 209/209 in two separate runs on fresh databases. Both applied 9 migrations, with no 57P01 errors and no hook timeouts. The new hierarchy-guard test and the contract tests (including getBrandingTokens) passed.
- **My own probes:**
  - The audit table refuses UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE for all three database roles.
  - The database refuses a direct business-unit cycle, the second of two concurrent re-parents and an 11th level.
  - Through the API, 25 concurrent re-parent races never committed both changes and never created a cycle.
  - The branding endpoint returns the seven seeded values marked provisional.
- **Acceptance suites and other checks:**
  - A12/A13/A14 24/24.
  - A18 clean start PASS.
  - A20 PASS.
  - Stopping the worker leaves the API running.
  - The three validators pass.
  - The CI config check detects all three of my negative edits.
- **Install sandbox (REQ-DLV-042):** 13 of 14 offline checks passed, matching D-057. My first attempt scored only 8/14 because the shared package store is read-only here; with a writable copy it matched.

The live-registry install (D-057) and the live CI run (D-058) are recorded as documented residuals. I did not claim them as verified.

**New finding F-DG1-232 (Low, non-mandatory, owner frontend-ux-engineer):**
- **What failed:** on my first run, one English test failed: "shell: navigation, language persistence and My Work". The skip link was expected to have focus but didn't. The spec runs serially, so the other 7 English journeys were skipped.
- **How often:** it failed again 1 time in 15 under CPU load. Without load, it passed in 28 of 29 executions.
- **Cause:** after reloading the page, the test waits only for the `<html lang>` attribute. That attribute is set before the app has drawn the page, so the test can press Tab too early. The product behaves correctly; the test's timing is wrong.
- **Fix:** wait for the navigation or heading to appear before pressing Tab.
- **Why this is FAIL, not PASS:** the gate requires every check to pass and the project runs with no retries. With this run recorded honestly as FAIL, the record cannot be PASS. No Critical, High or mandatory issue is open.

The domain-reviewer's round-2 files show as deleted in my sandbox's view of the repo. I didn't touch or read them; I assume this is how the sandbox hides other reviewers' records. My scratch clones have been removed.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG1/round-2/`:
- qa-verifier.json
- qa-verifier.findings.json
- qa-verifier.verifications.json
- qa-verifier.md

The logs and screenshots are in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG1/qa/round-2/`, and the new API probe is `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG1/qa/tests/dg1-r2-blackbox-probe.mjs`.
